facts.value: Allocates from AppSRT descriptor. Failure returns NULL without counter writes. Success zeroes HSD_PSAppSrt_804D7958[0] bytes of allocated storage, initializes next/gp/freefunc NULL, usedCount1, frameNum0, xA2 zero, stores supplied idnum without narrowing and status narrowed to u8. Writes translation XYZ and rotation XYZ zero, scale XYZ one. Increments live counter and raises peak if exceeded. Does not attach an owner or prove cached matrices/quaternion identity.
facts.rationale: State exact component writes, status narrowing, count width, and cleanup ordering without assuming transform identity or a forced inactive state. Shared struct is context only; no type entity or field claims are written.

facts.value: A newly allocated record has u16 usedCount1, translation/rotation XYZ zero, scale XYZ one, and no cleanup callback. Attach increments the stored count with no overflow check. Remove decrements it with no underflow check; exactly zero invokes optional cleanup and frees before clearing the owner slot. Null attach arguments and occupied slots return -1; removers require valid owner pointers and return -1 for missing attachment.
